title: Democracias imperfectas
goal: Read a closing assessment of these new democracies through O'Donnell's 1994 "delegative democracy" concept -- periodic clean elections alongside weak accountability, corruption, and persistently low institutional trust.

items: State the term O'Donnell proposed in 1994.
List the persistent problems many of these democracies carried.
Describe what late-1990s regional polls showed.
Use a fin de cuentas to draw a general conclusion.
I can state the term O'Donnell proposed in 1994.
I can explain what "delegative democracy" describes.
I can list the persistent problems many of these democracies carried.
I can describe what late-1990s regional polls showed.
I can use a fin de cuentas to draw a general conclusion.
